nom: Neutrogena On-The-Spot Acne Spot Treatment Cream with 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide

avis.texte: I’ve been using this acne cream for a few weeks and I’m very happy with the results. It helped reduce redness and breakouts without drying out my skin too much. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling. My skin looks clearer and smoother, and new pimples seem to heal faster. I would definitely recommend it to anyone struggling with mild to moderate acne.

avis.titre: Fast-acting spot treatment that really works
avis.texte: This has been one of the most effective spot treatments I’ve used. A small amount goes a long way, and I noticed blemishes looking smaller and less red after just a couple of applications. It dries quickly, layers well under moisturizer, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling overly dry when used as directed. It’s a product I keep on hand for the occasional breakout, and it has consistently worked well for me.

I did not like the effect of this product at all. I bought this product thinking it will help me with my breakouts (I am 30 years old and still have these teenagers breakouts. I tried many products over the years, took pills that helped a lot but made my skin very sensitive). I use Neutrogena's Oil-Free Acne Wash Facial Cleanser, and I was hoping this will be good for me. It is the first time I am trying a product like this one. I am always afraid to try anything new because of my over sensitive skin. The product arrived on time and in good shape. The tube is small, but considering the amount you need to apply on your face, there is much cream material inside. It is very easy to use and has no smell. I read the reviews that some people had great results and thought maybe I would be lucky. I did not. I believe that what happened is that my skin does not react well to the active ingredient (Benzoyl Peroxide), and the result was I had more breakouts on places where I applied it. I used this product for two weeks, and nothing good happened. Once I have stopped using this product, my face started to calm down. It has been three weeks since I have stopped and My face is still healing from the breakouts. I guess that if you are not that sensitive to the Benzoyl, you get better results, but this was not my case.

I put a teeny tiny bit on a spot that was forming on my forehead. One application. One small amount. That area of my forehead has been red and dry since then. It's been about 5 days and the skin has not gotten better. To this product's credit, the acne spot went away, but the red and dryness is way worse. Will my skin ever return to normal?
